datasets.label: AAVSO APASS DR9 (Gaia archive TAP mirror: external.apassdr9)
datasets.query: SELECT recno, raj2000, dej2000, nobs, mobs, b_v, vmag, e_vmag, u_e_vmag, bmag, e_bmag, r_mag, e_r_mag, i_mag, e_i_mag FROM external.apassdr9 WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',raj2000,dej2000),CIRCLE('ICRS',4.828083333333334,59.13905555555556,0.5))=1 AND vmag IS NOT NULL ORDER BY vmag

datasets.label: Gaia DR3 gaiadr3.gaia_source (ESA Gaia archive TAP)
datasets.query: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id, ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_g_mean_flux, phot_g_mean_flux_error, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, ruwe, phot_variable_flag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',4.828083333333334,59.13905555555556,0.5))=1 AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag < 19 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag
